mcqs.question: What was the 2026 theme of the UN Day for South-South Cooperation observed on September 12?
options: Solidarity Rising: Global Alliance for Inclusive and Innovative Development
When Every Voice Counts, Democracy Delivers
Invest in Peace: For Everyone, Everywhere, Every Day
mcqs.explanation: The 2026 theme of the UN Day for South-South Cooperation was “Solidarity Rising: Global Alliance for Inclusive and Innovative Development.” “When Every Voice Counts, Democracy Delivers” was associated with the International Day of Democracy, while the other options were themes of different observances.

mcqs.question:
With reference to World Rivers Day observed in September 2026, consider the following statements:
Statement A: World Rivers Day was observed on September 27 with the theme “Waterways in Our Communities”.
Statement B: World Rivers Day is associated with the World Rivers Day Council and UNEP / UNGA.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is true: World Rivers Day was observed on September 27, with the theme “Waterways in Our Communities”. Statement B is false because its associated bodies are the World Rivers Day Council and UN-Water, not UNEP / UNGA.
